summary.short_summary: The team discussed strategies to accelerate deal momentum for Imaginary Content with a focus on closing sales by June. Jack Chiappe outlined a timeline that includes a two-week prospecting phase, a month for Letters of Intent (LOIs), and a two-week period to collect offers post-LOI, aimed at minimizing prolonged sales cycles. Ahmed Zia highlighted a list of 47 potential buyers and committed to segmenting them into interested, uninterested, and unreachable categories. Emphasis was placed on proactive, personalized outreach methods, combining calls with Information Memorandum (IM) sharing to enhance buyer engagement. Financial updates were deemed critical, with the current EBITDA at 1.5 million, and both Jack and Ahmed stressed the importance of timely, accurate financial data for buyer confidence. The conversation also covered the need for improved tracking systems and team coordination to maintain sales momentum.
